title: From prompt to PR: sandbox-validated dbt changes before human review
description:
How Careem built an AI agent that writes, tests, and validates dbt models in a sandbox before a human reviews them. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Careem, the UAE super app behind ride-hailing, food and grocery delivery, and remittance, supports more than 5,000 dbt models with a lean data engineering team. Its AI agent compiles, tests, and materializes every change in a sandbox, and a spec-locking step makes the agent ask about grain, metric definitions, and filters up front. About 90% of new models now come from the framework, and metric delivery dropped from two to three weeks to hours.

In this session you'll learn:
• Why confidence in AI-generated code comes from end-to-end validation, not the code generator
• How spec locking prevents ambiguous metrics like "revenue"
• How an open source stack supports AI-written dbt models at scale

Speakers: Careem data engineering team

Learn more about dbt and AI: https://www.getdbt.com/product/ai
